svg.title: Next research objective
svg.desc: Develop a prototype neural network surrogate tailored to Great Lakes wave-ice processes and, once reference data are available, evaluate its predictive performance and computational cost against an existing numerical model.

g.text: The next research objective is to develop a prototype neural network
surrogate for Great Lakes wave-ice processes and, once reference data
are available, evaluate its predictive performance and computational
cost against an existing numerical model.
